_comment: Example settings.json — the file in use is ~/.config/proton-drive-cli-sync/settings.json ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/proton-drive-cli-sync/settings.json when that variable is set), not a copy beside the scripts. Every key is optional: a missing key falls back to the default shown here. The file is also written by the GUI (Language… and Configuration… dialogs), which preserves unknown keys.
